## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      1 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 8, 2026 - Jul 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Mikołaj Ściobłowski_, Apr 8, 2026, 1/5: "Laughably bad programming. The voiceover will spam you with useless info instead of playing interval audio cues, a bug that was present FIVE YEARS ago. [08/04/26] The most poorly coded running app managed to get even worse, it doesn't even launch now, congrats ASICS."
            2. _Michelle Robbinkane_, Jun 30, 2026, 4/5: "This App is Awesome! It's tracking and sharing my progress with my husband and I perfectly. And the challenges keep me motivated! But I'm struggling with the programmed Cheerleaders. The Mademoiselle voice has taken over the Drill Sargent and Boston Fan voices and I can not fix this. I have tried several things but it won't change. I hope the glitch gets fixed so I can give 5 stars."
            3. _Jonas Huovila_, May 18, 2026, 4/5: "Freezes/Slow to open up sometimes, besides that an AWESOME APP!!! ❤❤❤"
